comparison: Same frozen updater and per-scan identical Z; adapted versus fixed mature reader. Independent full-Z adapted/fixed controls.
limitations: Reader swap is an off-training-distribution intervention. No training-parameter matched superiority or latency claim; audit timing suppressed.

source_contract.initialization: Kaiming hidden layers, candidate N(0,.001)/bias0, gate weight0/bias4; mature reader copied exactly. Signed candidate is required by preactivation Z.
source_contract.loss: Ordinary: labelled GT +.2 foreground head KD +.5 signedZ feature KD. Joint reader also receives labelled GT +.2 head KD on full refresh to preserve full-path accuracy. No Y feature KD.
source_contract.optimizer: AdamW updater1e-4, joint reader1e-5, wd1e-4 clip5. Plateau factor.5 patience1 absolute.0005 min1e-6. Stop min6/stale4/updater lr<=2.5e-5.
source_contract.state: Signed Z96 = frozen shallow projection plus frozen deep projection BEFORE first spatial readout convolution; only FM/Z persist. Own recurrence; ego nearest alignment, period3/.25s.
source_contract.teacher: Fixed complete Z from same E/FM; fixed reader and heads produce targets. Ordinary teacher output discarded, never written to student Z. Full refresh writes fixed Z by declared policy.
source_contract.trainable: Updater plus separate mature spatial reader when joint; frozen reader control differs only in reader trainability. Frozen BN running statistics, trainable reader affine in joint. Pillar/FM/stem/H/deep/projections/heads and independent teacher fixed.
source_contract.update: E128+oldZ96+valid ->1x1(64)/ReLU ->two3x3(64)/ReLU ->signed1x1(96). g=.95sigmoid*valid; g*old+(1-g)*candidate. Dense5x5 dependencies; no local skipping yet.
source_contract.validation: Full5794/1738 fixed H control, frozen full Z+reader control, own Z recurrence; joint adds full current Z+adapted reader. Shared GPU timing null. Branch Conv MACsx2 measured; nonconv/Pillar pointwise Linear omitted consistently.

split: Full validation5794 scans/1738 labels; no fitting or selection
